utterances.speaker: Eli

utterances.speaker: Cleo

utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Dane — the repair drive’s moved to Sunday at the community center now. I’ll keep you posted if anything else changes.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Rosa — Sunday at the community center works for me. I’ll bring my hammer and screwdriver, and I’ll look for the wrench set before I head over.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Wonderful, thanks, Dane — your hammer and screwdriver will be a big help. If you find the wrench set, bring that along too, and I’ll let you know if we need anything else.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Thanks, Vik — that’d really help. We still need a few more hands for the small repairs, so spreading the word would be great.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Absolutely — I’ll keep spreading the word around the block and see who can help with the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Thanks, Vik — I really appreciate it. If you hear of anyone who can help, send them our way.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Has the date been confirmed yet, or are we still waiting on the group?

utterances.speaker: Uli

utterances.speaker: Mina

utterances.speaker: Ira

utterances.speaker: Opal

utterances.text: Tess: Oh, that’s great — Sunday at the community center works perfectly. I’ll keep passing the word along if anyone else has tools or can lend a hand.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great, thanks — so the repair drive is set for Sunday at the community center, right?

utterances.speaker: Tess

utterances.speaker: Rey

utterances.speaker: Quinn

utterances.speaker: Rey

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Yes, that’s still the plan for Saturday morning at the community center. Thanks for checking — I’m glad we’re keeping it on track.

utterances.text: Jules: Sounds good, Mara — I’ll bring whatever basic tools I have and be there when you send the timing.

utterances.speaker: Pia

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Sounds good, Pia. Send it over when you have it, and I’ll pass it along.

utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Vik — and just a quick update: the repair drive is now Sunday at the community center, not Saturday on the front porch.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Got it — I’ll start telling folks it’s Sunday at the community center instead. I’ll keep spreading the word and remind everyone to show up then.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Vik — I really appreciate you spreading the word. I’m still pulling together the homes that need repairs, and I’ll send you the addresses as soon as I have them.
